Commentary.Commentary: Now, the Afghans have a big task ahead of them. A positive start will be key in the chase, as they have quality bowlers to tighten the noose in the middle overs on a relatively slower deck. You don't want to miss it. Join us on the other side of the break.

The Afghanistan bowlers will be disappointed with the fact that they couldn't capitalize on the advantageous position they were in at one stage. They will rue the fact that they didn't finish things off and let Bangladesh run away like they did. Aftab Alam led the charge with 3 wickets while Mujeeb and Rashid picked 1 apiece. Though, it can be argued that Mahmudullah and Kayes did play them well, especially Rashid, taking no major risks against him.

A splendid turnaround from Bangladesh. From being 87/5 they have managed to almost touch the 250-mark and it's all thanks to the century stand between Mahmudullah and Kayes. Electing to bat, the Tigers lost a couple of early wickets but found their way back when Das and Rahim put up 63 between them. Though, some brainfade moments in the middle which resulted in a couple of run outs put Afghanistan back on top. The game seemed to slip away but the marathon Mahmudullah-Kayes stand of 128 turned the tide in their favour again and put Bangladesh in a competitive position at the end of the innings.
FOUR! What a way to finish the innings. Superb shot from Imrul Kayes. He leans into the full ball outside off and drives it ever so well through the covers for a boundary. BANGLADESH FINISH ON 249/7!

That's poor from Shahzad, concedes a run unnecessarily. Naib bowls a length ball down leg and Mehidy looks to work it away by moving a bit across. Misses and so does the keeper and the batsmen steal a bye.
Wide! Seeing the batsman give the charge Naib hurls it too far outside off. It's across the tramline and wide is signalled.
Kayes goes down the ground as well, through mid off though and earns a run.
Dances down the track and drills it to long on for a single.
Full and well outside off, Mehidy walks a long way across his stumps and whips this through square leg. A couple of runs are taken.
Kayes moves across and slogs this on the leg side to pick up a single.
Alam fires this full just outside off, Hasan looks to push it into the off side but gets a thick edge towards the third man region. He is off the mark with a brace.
Mehidy Hasan comes in next.

OUT! A bit of a comical dismissal. Trying to be too smart there Mortaza and perishes in the effort. He goes down looking to scoop it over the keeper's head, moves much before the ball has left the bowler's arm, Alam does well to float in a slower ball, the right-hander has to wait a bit longer and then tries to scoop it, gets a top edge and the ball goes up towards Shahzad who does not have to move a step to take it safely.
Kayes goes for the big hit but mistimes this as the ball lobs towards the mid on region and the batsmen cross to add a run.
Fuller and in line with the stumps, driven down to long on for a single.
Mashrafe just manages to keep the yorker out by bringing his bat down in time. Well bowled Alam.

FOUR! Luck favors the brave, and this time it favors Bangladesh. Mortaza looks to go for the slog over mid-wicket but gets a thick inside edge and the french cut helps the ball races across the fine leg boundary.

The Bangladesh captain will feel that he has missed an opportunity to add 6 runs to the total. Khan bowls a long hop and drags the length very short in line with the stumps. Mortaza hammers the pull but he could not have found the fielder better. Gets a single and will be back on strike.
Mortaza comes inside the line of the delivery and tries to heave it over the mid-wicket region. He mistimes it but between the fielders to get back for a brace.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball into the covers.
Flicked towards deep square leg to cross over.

FOUR! Gutsy! Plays the reverse sweep and gets it right this time. Kayes goes down, looks to go for the shot and times it brilliantly. He has made good use of the bowler's pace. The ball races across the third man region for a boundary.
Quicker but shorter, Mortaza keeps his weight back and pulls this towards square leg to get the well set Kayes on strike.
Rashid Khan brought back into the attack.
FOUR! That is not a good end to the over as Alam bangs this one short, it is a slower ball again but this time Kayes picks it up early, smashes the pull shot through deep square leg for a boundary.
Played through the mid-wicket region by the Bangladesh captain to get off the mark.
Alam fires this one on the batsman's pads, Kayes flicks this through mid-wicket for a run.
Dished out wide of off, Kayes reaches out but fails to connect. Dot ball results.
Mashrafe Mortaza, the Bangladesh skipper, walks in the middle.

OUT! The massive partnership of 128 is broken at last. What a valiant effort from Mahmudullah. Came in at a time when his team was in dire trouble, has bailed them out superbly well. Alam goes completely opposite with his line, length and speed. He lands this very short and way wide of off. He seems to have rolled his fingers over it and the leg cutter reaches Mahmudullah on its way down. The batsman tries to hit it hard over the deep cover fence. Gets good connection but not enough distance, as he could not hit it with the desired power because of the slower pace. Rashid Khan at sweeper cover doesn't move a single step as he takes it easily. Big wicket for Afghanistan, could make a difference of around 15-20 runs to the final total.
Nice yorker to start off. It's right in the blockhole. Mahmudullah tries to dig it out but the ball slips through under his bat to Shahzad behind.
Aftab Alam comes into the attack.
Right in the blockhole, nicely bowled by Naib. Kayes does well to bring his bat down in time and block it out.

FOUR! That's hit really well! Wide full toss outside off, Kayes gets low, reaches out for it and smacks it square through the off side. Past the vacant cover-point region and the ball beats the diving fielder in the deep as well. Well hit.
Quite full on the stumps, Mahmudullah lofts it down towards wide long off. One more to the total.
Angling in from around off, takes the inside edge of the bat before striking the pads and rolling on the off side. A quick run is stolen.
Full ball outside off, driven through covers for another run.

15th ODI fifty for Imrul Kayes! A superb knock from the southpaw. After getting Mushfiqur Rahim run out, he's done well to hang in there and play a useful knock for his side. He gets to the milestone by coming forward and driving it square through point for a single.
Gulbadin Naib to bowl once more.
Kayes works this flatter one in line with the stumps through mid-wicket to retain the strike.
Mahmudullah has worked it off his pads behind square and has taken an easy single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Starys on his pads as Mahmudullah goes for the flick. The ball kisses his thigh pad and runs down fine down the leg side for the batsmen to run back for a brace.

SIX! He goes after Rashid, again and does so with some style, again. Makes a bit of room and goes down to play the slog sweep, the ball is fired in quicker and on a fuller length on middle. Mahmudullah finds the middle of his bat and the ball this times easily clears the fence and another maximum results.
Goes for the reverse sweep on the very first ball and misses it completely to get hit high on the back of his forearm.
Mahmudullah punches this short of a length ball towards the cover-point region to pinch a single.
Slower and fuller around off is driven superbly through covers to get a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot into square leg for a single.
Paddle sweep tried but missed to get hit on the pads.
Gets low and across to turn this one through mid-wicket with a closed bat face to get a run.
Nabi, the wily offie, gives it a bit more air and keeps it on off. The ball sneaks through the gap between bat and pad and beats Kayes' tentative push.
Fuller and a bit slower, The southpaw works it through mid-wicket off the back foot to cross over and retain strike.
Played to the mid-wicket region to get a single. Smart batting this.

SIX! KABOOM! That's outta here. Takes courage to do this to Rashid. Mahmudullah, after the 3 dot balls, goes down for the slog sweep and gets some sweet connection. The sound made when ball met the bat was so good to hear. The ball sails over the ropes for a 94 meter maximum. The 100-run stand comes up and it's a crucial one for Bangladesh.
Again looks to flick this one into the leg side but the ball skids through on landing and beats Mahmudullah to get hit on his thigh pads. Three dots in a row by Rashid.
Goes for the sweep but misses to get rapped on the pads. Second dot now, pressure building.
Very full on off,   pushed to the cover region by Mahmudullah. Dot to start the 43rd.
Rashid Khan into the attack again.
Kayes goes back to this quicker but shorter one on off, flicks it towards mid-wicket to get a brace and ends the 42nd over. 8 more to go now.
A bit shorter and the batsman goes back and punches it through cover-point for a run.
Kayes does well to lean across and close his bat face to pinch a run through mid-wicket.
A bit shorter of a driving length, Mahmudullah goes back and pushes this through covers to get to the other end.
Full on off, driven to long on for a run.
Quicker and very full from around the wicket, the batsman tries to dig it out but gets a thick outer edge towards third man for a single.
Mohammad Nabi comes back into the attack.
Charges down the track and goes through the line over the cover region. The timing is not that immaculate and the fielder manages to cut it short of the deep cover boundary to keep them to three.
A bit fuller this on off, Mahmudullah drives this to mid on. No run as he hit it too well and there was no time to cross over to the other end.
Shorter in length and Kayes pulls it hard but straight to the fielder at deep square leg for just a single.

On a good length on middle and off, angling into Mahmudullah who flicks this one to deep square leg and jogs across to get his 20th half century in ODIs. Needs to continue for his team to put up a competitive total.
Quicker and fuller on off, Kayes is well set to drive his through covers and cross over.

Short ball outside off to start off. He seems to have rolled his fingers over the ball as it was dipping while passing the batsman. He gets beaten by pace and aborts from his pull shot at the last moment.

Powerplay 3 has been signaled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings. Also, Mujeeb is going off the field. Doesn't seem too comfortable, must have picked up some kind of niggle. And, Aftab Alam comes back into the attack.
Does well this time to open the bat face and run it down to third man and will be back on strike the next over.
Drives this full length delivery on the stumps straight to mid off.
Mahmudullah this time leans across and drives it through mid on to get a run.
Fuller and attacking the stumps this time, driven through covers for a single.

FOUR! Naib changes his pace and bowls this one slower but makes an error in giving width. Kayes accepts it with glee and smashes an uppish cover drive for a cracking boundary. Bangladesh dearly need more of these.
Kayes whips this full delivery coming into him towards mid-wicket.
A bit slower outside off, is played to short third man. Good over again by Mujeeb.
The batsman punches this straight to the fielder at cover.

Smart running, this. Mahmudullah goes back and gives himself a bit of room to punch this one to cover-point. Mahmudullah, on completing the first run, sees the opportunity to steal a second as the fielder there is a bit on his heels. The batsmen easily take the brace.
Mahmudullah flicks this straighter ball to the square leg region. No run on offer though.
A bit shorter this from Mujeeb, Kayes goes back and punches it through covers to change strike.
Kayes tries to flick but gets rapped on the pads.

Six out of six from Naib on his return. Mahmudullah waits for the ball to arrive and tucks it into the square leg region. Mujeeb there misfields and the batsmen have taken advantage of it by coming back for the second. Amazing in his bowling but has to work on his fielding, the young mystery spinner.
Defended off the back foot by Mahmudullah.
Kayes works this one angled on his pads towards square leg for an easy single.
Third slower one on the trot but the right-hander this time finds the gap in the cover region to change strike.
Well bowled again as he is giving no pace to the batsman to work with, Mahmudullah defends this time.
Slower ball to start, Mahmudullah waits and drives to covers.
Gulbadin Naib back into the attack.
Pinched into covers to retain strike. Rahman continues to impress.
Mahmudullah tries to work this one on the middle stump line into the leg side but misses to get hit on the pads.
Imrul works this straighter delivery into the square leg region to change strike.
A bit slower in pace and the right-hander waits a bit longer to push it into the point region for a single.
Keeps this a bit full and Mahmudullah punches it solidly through the cover region to pick up a brace.
Tries to sweep this one but misses and gets rapped on the pads.
Mahmudullah has cut this fiercely to the fielder at sweeper cover and he gets a brace for it.
Similar ball this but this time Imrul finds the gap through mid off and gets one run.
Very full in line with the stumps, driven to mid off.
Nabi fires this quicker one on his pads as Mahmudullah flicks it to exchange strike.
Shorter outside off, the right-hander rocks back and punches it into covers.
Tossed up delivery and angling into him, Imrul uses the angle to tuck it into square leg for a single.
This pair is doing well here. Not taking any risks against Khan. Mahmudullah just works this off his hips to short fine leg.
Fuller outside off, pushed just wide of point and both batsmen are on their toes as they complete the run with ease.
Fuller ball attacking the stumps, blocked with a straight blade in response.
Imrul uses the depth of the crease as he goes deep inside and works this spinning delivery into him to the mid-wicket fielder.
The leg break outside off, full in length, played towards point for one.
A little too full for Rashid's liking, enables Kayes to wrist this down to long on before the ball can even turn. Gets a single for doing so.
Drifting in on middle and leg, slower through the air, Imrul tucks it towards the mid-wicket area for a single.
Similar ball, similar shot and a different result this time. Only one run taken.
Sliding across, outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it through point. Shah out in the deep mops it up and two runs are taken.
Worked off the pads on the leg side for no run.
Spinning in on middle and leg, turned in front of mid-wicket.

From around the wicket, it's sliding across the batsman, Mahmudullah slaps the punch through cover-point. The fielder in the deep does well to cut it off and restrict the batsmen to just two runs. Maybe Nabi should consider coming over the wicket, the round the wicket angle limits his options and really opens up the off side for the batsman.
Mohammad Nabi back on.
Just 1 off the over. Superb from the leggie. Imrul Kayes cuts this away on the off side again for nothing.
Throws this outside off, cut away to point. Another dot.
Quicker one again, turning in on middle and leg, Imrul works it to backward square leg.
Fuller and straighter, it's played back to the bowler.
The googly again, well outside off, Kayes reaches out to it and cuts it to backward point.
The wrong one on middle, spinning down, Mahmudullah flicks it down in front of square leg and runs through to complete the run.
Rashid Khan returns to the bowling attack.

Drinks are on the field. Bangladesh have recovered well after that middle-overs mishap. From 81/2 they were reeling at 87/5, all down to some horrible communication in the middle, resulting in needless run outs. But since then, Kayes and Mahmudullah have taken things under control with a 50-partnership and even taken the attack to the opposition bowlers on occasion. This final phase should be an interesting one to say the least.
Sweet sound off the bat as Mahmudullah drives it right off the middle through to sweeper cover. A single results and that's the end of the over.
The batsman positions himself well behind the line and meets it with the full face of the bat.

FOUR! That's crunched away! Brings up the 50-run stand too. Short and wide, Mahmudullah cracks it past the diving point fielder and even beats the sweeper in the deep to send it across the boundary line. Super shot.
A good contest, this. Length delivery on off, Mahmudullah defends this to the right of the bowler. Both sides not giving anything away easily. This is good cricket all around.
Goes fuller on this occasion, on middle and leg, it's defended back down the track.
Starts off with a bumper around off, the batsman lets it be. Looks at the umpire but doesn't get the wide he was looking for. The umpire though signals one for the over.
Cut away square through point. A brace results from it.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Mahmudullah looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Hit down to long on and Imrul gets to the other end.
Stays back to this one coming in and keeps it out rather comfortably.
Short again, outside off from around the wicket, cracked towards sweeper cover. The fielder in the deep does well to cut it off and keeps the batsmen to just two runs.
No spin whatsoever on this as Mujeeb bowls it shorter outside off, Mahmudullah punches it through covers after backing away and gets a single for it.
Fires in the yorker, it's in line of the stumps, the southpaw does well to jam it out.
The slip is moved out now.
Angling back in on middle stump, Imrul once more moves inside the line and works it on the leg side. Once he played it, he realizes he missed out. Could have lifted it over the infield.
Taps this down in front of covers but won't get any run for it.
Switches the angle to around the wicket and bowls a length ball on off, Kayes moves inside the line and wrists it to short mid-wicket.
There's a slip in place now.
On the shorter side of things, outside off, it's placed through the same region again, just a single this time.
Short of a good length outside off, Mahmudullah hangs back and punches it nicely through the gap in the covers for a couple of runs.
Aftab Alam is back.
Shortish outside off, played to point. A single is collected. Nice partnership building between these two. Worth 36 now.
Coming in on middle and leg, it goes off the thigh pad of the batsman who tries to flick it away.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot down to long on for a single.

Good effort from Rahmat Shah in the deep. Imrul Kayes hits this through the big gap in the covers. It seems the ball will cross the rope but Rahmat Shah out in the deep covers a lot of ground to his left and makes a good diving stop. Keeps the batsmen down to two.
From around the wicket, it's darted around off, blocked back down the track with ease.

Quick through the air, straighter in line, Kayes works it towards backward square leg. Nabi there moves to his left, tries to take it with one hand but is sloppy with the effort and lets it through. Conceded two as a result.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is called back on.
FOUR! A half-tracker from Shenwari and it's put away. Mahmudullah shifts his weight onto the back foot and pulls it aerially wide of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Punched off the backfoot by Mahmudullah through the covers. Two runs added to the total.
Some good flight on this occasion, full on middle and leg, clipped through square leg for a single.
Mahmudullah plays the same shot, but with more power. Muscles it to deep mid-wicket for one more.
Short again, spinning in, Kayes helps the pull through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flat and quick on the stumps, flicked down in front of short mid-wicket.
Samiullah Shenwari on to roll his arm over.
Quick and flat and short outside off, a solid punch is offered straight to the man at cover.
Knocked down to long on and one more run is added to the total.
Back to over the wicket, the googly on a shorter length, Mahmudullah backs away and punches it to cover-point. The fielder from point moves to his right and the batsmen take a single.
Rashid comes around the wicke to the left-hander and bowls a quicker one full outside off. Kayes forces it square through point and changes ends.
Down the ground this time, it's knocked down to long off for a run.
Takes a big stride forward and pushes it to covers.
The left-hander goes square, flicks it through square leg for a couple. Better over for Bangladesh, 8 runs from it.

Could have been another run out. The Tigers look nervy out in the middle. Kayes works this on the leg side and initially calls for the run. Though this time, he sends his partner back in time. No harm done.
In the off stump channel from around the wicket, firmly blocked in front of cover.
Outside the line of off stump again, punched wide of point for a run.

FOUR! A boundary after almost 5 overs for Bangladesh. Just shows the dominance of the Afghans. They need more of these. Length ball with width offered outside off, Mahmudullah fiercely cuts this behind point and finds the fence.
Fullish in length, straighter in line, Kayes works it through square leg for a single.
Gulbadin Naib is back.
Another dot. Tight over from the leggie. Brings out the googly this time but Mahmudullah picks it up. Goes back and forces it away on the off side.
Short, flat and outside off, dabbed with an open face to point.
Plays this with the spin and pushes it to the cover region for nothing.
Keeps it full, a lot of air and close to off, it's blocked out off the front foot.
Spinning away from outside off, Mahmudullah plays it from the outer half towards point.
Landing on a driving length, Kayes plants his front foot forward and flicks it through to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Imrul comes forward to this loopy delivery and eases it down to long off. One run to end the over.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
Some air on this occasion from Nabi, full in length, defended gently beside the track on the off side.
Once again, Kayes makes a defensive push in the bowler's direction.
Nice and straight from Nabi, it's played back to the bowler easily.
Floats this up on the stumps, worked wide of short fine leg for one run.
Loopy and full, attacking the stumps, met with the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kayes plays that off the front foot and blocks it well.
Quick and flat outside off, punched off the back foot square through point for a single.
Short and turning in, on the stumps, pulled away along the carpet in front of square leg for a single.
Some turn inwards, on middle and leg, blocked down on the leg side.
Short again, it's smacked off the back foot through the covers for a couple of runs.
Shorter in length and spinning in around off, Mahmudullah camps back and defends it right under his nose.
Uses his feet to step out and blocks this one down.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
Works it off his pads into the leg side but for no run.
Slanting across outside off, full in length, pushed by coming forward to point for one. Straightaway gets off the mark.
The wrong 'un outside off, dabbed to point to end another successful over from Rashid.
Mahmudullah walks into the middle now. Bangladesh in big trouble.

OUT! Rahim is out of here! This is a big, big wicket for the Afghans. Kayes works this in front of square leg and calls for the run. Mushfiqur is halfway down the track and at this point, Imrul sends his back. Nabi gets to the ball and throws it to Rashid. The bowler collects, runs back and takes the bails off. Rahim is well out of the crease, but the issue remains whether he took the bails off with his leg first. Replays roll in as the umpire refers it upstairs and they show that all is fine. No problem with the run out. Rahim makes the long walk back with his head dropped down.
Well what's happening here? Total mayhem. Rahim has been run out, but has Rashid fallen on the stumps before taking the bails off? Only thing that could save him there. Let's see now...
Hangs back to this one and keeps it out with the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Just uses the pace and a misfield from the man at short fine leg helps his cause. Turning in on the pads, Kayes works it fine down the leg side. The fielder moves to his left, tumbles but can't stop the ball. A boundary results. With this, Kayes completes 2000 runs in ODI cricket.
Spinning away from around off, pushed into the covers for a single.
The googly from Rashid, on middle and leg, worked away towards square leg. Dot ball.
Short and flat from Nabi, Kayes guards it out safely off the back foot.
Another one turned away on the leg side. No run taken.
Drifting in on leg, Kayes clips it off his pads fine down the leg side for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Doesn't spin much, but it's slower through the air around off, Kayes meets it with the full face of the bat.
Quicker delivery on the stumps, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Imrul Kayes is the new man in.

OUT! THIS IS SUICIDE! Shakib Al Hasan had come at No 5, instead of walking out at the fall of the first wicket, as he wanted to play Rashid Khan himself and negate his threat. But his plan has failed miserably as he is run out on just his second ball. Bangladesh now in deep deep trouble. Not good cricket there by the experienced all-rounder. Going back to the ball, it is a googly on his pads, the southpaw flicks it to mid-wicket and just takes off. Mushfiqur sees no run there and asks Shakib to go back. Shakib slips as he looks to turn and get back. Shenwari, the fielder there, picks it up and fires in a one bounce throw at the striker's end which hits the target bang-on and they start the wild celebrations. They have got the big fish.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Shakib Al Hasan is the new batsman in for Bangladesh. He usually comes in at number 3 for his side, but this time has come down the order so that he can deal with Afghanistan's biggest weapon, Rashid Khan.

OUT! Some classic cricket on the previous delivery and some irresponsible cricket on the next. This is full and on the off stump, ripping away late, it has an inward drift. He goes down looking to sweep, a risky shot against this bowler because of his pace. Gets a top edge on it and Insanullah in the slip region settles under it and takes it with a couple of steps to his right. That is a very sad ending to a promising innings.

FOUR! Class! That is so elegant and classic from Das. Rashid tosses this one up and keeps it on off. Das, ever so gently, plays a lofted extra cover drive. The timing is exquisite and placement is even better as the ball races through for a boundary. That's how you play Rashid Khan.
A bit shorter this from Rashid and this allows Rahim to rock back and punch it into the gap at cover-point and goes to the other end.
A flatter and fuller one to start, Rahim plays it into mid-wicket.
Rashid Khan, Bangladesh's biggest threat, comes into the attack.
Nabi keeps a bit shorter around off, Rahim goes back and across to work it into the square leg region and gets one.
Das tucks this full delivery into mid-wicket to get a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away by Rahim for a single.
Similar ball to the previous one, Rahim tries to cut but misses.
A bit shorter and quicker outside off, Rahim tries to play it late towards the third man region but hits it straight to the man at short third man.
Tossed up on off, flicked into the mid-wicket region for a single.

Drinks. Afghanistan did well to get two early wickets and force the Bangladesh batsmen on the back foot. But the pair of Liton Das and Mushfiqur Rahim have steadied their ship. They will want to continue further and go deeper into their innings. Afghanistan will look to break this stand as early as possible.
A bit shorter this on off, cut to point.

SIX! A maximum this time. Alam again bangs it in short and gets the ball rising onto Rahim, Rahim stays back and goes for the pull shot and gets a top edge. The ball flies down towards fine leg and the pace on it has taken the ball sailing over the ropes to bring up the first biggie of the innings. The 50 stand also comes up.

FOUR! Rahim gives the charge, sees the ball banged in short but still goes for the pull. The front foot forehand swat goes through the mid-wicket region racing through and across the ropes in a flash. Rahim has had enough of it, it seems.
Length ball driven back to the bowler.
Marginally shorter of good length around off, Das taps it into the point region to get a quick single.
Bouncer! Das ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.
Aftab Alam returns to the attack.

Rahim improvises as he opens his stance completely, covers the stumps and tries to go for the scoop shot and gets the ball behind over the keeper's head. He paddle-scoops it for a brace to end the over.
Fuller one is flicked into the mid-wicket region to pick up another single.
Das goes down and paddles this full ball on middle, gets a fine touch on it and the ball races towards the fine leg boundary and the batsmen come back for a brace.
A bit fuller this one on middle and off, Rahim plants his front foot across and works this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Nabi from around the wicket keeps it in line with the stumps, Rahim comes forward and blocks it out with soft hands.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fires this on his pads, Rahim turns it into the square leg region for a single.
Good bowling this by Naib, he's not drifting from his line or length and Rahim has to block it out off the back foot this time.
The batsman has played it to the point region.

Naib again bowls this on a length outside off, it's the leg cutter this time, Rahim looks to steer it down to third man by opening the bat face but gets beaten by the slower pace and Shahzad does the rest behind.
Good ball by Naib as he keeps this in the corridor of uncertainty, Rahim defends off the front foot.
Rahim has missed out on a scoring opportunity. Naib lands this short and wide of off, it's there to be cut and Rahim does exactly that, but again he has found the fielder at point.
Rahim goes down for the sweep, connects it well but the ball goes straight to the fielder at deep square leg. He keeps strike.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Nabi drops it short, Rahim goes back and cuts it past point, gets a brace as the timing is not perfect.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, flicked again to mid-wicket for a single.
A bit straighter this one, angling into the batsman, Rahim flicks it into the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up on off, driven softly to mid on to get a single.
Mohammad Nabi is brought on into the attack.
Fraction straight in line, worked off the pads on the leg side for a run.
Good delivery. Angles in first before shaping away off the seam. Rahim closes the face a little early and hence it goes off the leading edge down to third man. The batsmen take one.
Outside off on a good length, dabbed to point from within the crease. A single is taken.
Wide! Banged in short but it's too short, wide called by the umpire.
Just ahead of a length, around off, kept out off the front foot.

FOUR! Wonderful aggression from Liton Das. Stays positive and gives the charge to this length ball. Lifts it cleanly over mid off and the ball seemingly hits the rope. The umpire isn't sure, it looks like a maximum to the naked eye, but it's taken upstairs. Replays show that it bounced just before crashing into it. So a boundary is signalled.
Good length ball close to off, blocked from within the crease.
Full and straight, flicked to mid-wicket.

Dropped! Will this be the turning point? Rahim looks to play at this fuller length ball around off, he tentatively pokes his bat in front of his pads to block this one but the ball spins away ever so slightly and takes the outside edge which flies to first slip off Shahzad's pads. Janat moves swiftly to his left, gets his hands to it but cannot hold onto it. The ball drops down onto the ground and Mushfiqur Rahim survives.
Slower and fuller ball on off is flicked into the mid-wicket region and the batsmen run a single.
Hangs back this time and blocks it well.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Big appeal for LBW turned down, hit outside the line of off stump this. Mujeeb continues with his tight line and length around off, Das comes forward to work it away into the leg side. The ball lands and nips in prodigiously to hit Rahim on his pads. The Afghans go up in an appeal but are negated by the umpire. This wily spinner continues to impress.
Fuller again around off, goes back and pushes it to point.
A bit slower and shorter in length, tapped into the point region.
Length ball on off is kept out safely off the front foot.
Rahim has played this to the mid-wicket region.

FOUR! That's 5000 ODI runs for Rahim, the third Bangladeshi to get to that mark after Tamim Iqbal and Shakib Al Hasan. Rahim takes on the short ball as he swivels and looks to pull. He gets a top edge though and it goes over the keeper's head to bring Rahim's first boundary. He's up and running.
Opens the bat face and guides it towards third man to get off strike on the very first ball of the over.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Now a maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the 40th over.
Mujeeb is just not giving anything away here as he keeps it fuller around off. The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up around off, kept out safely off the front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller and straighter, worked into square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Well bowled, Mujeeb. Totally bamboozling the batsmen is this mystery spinner. He keeps it full around off, Rahim tries to drive it through the off side but gets beaten as the ball turns away. Shahzad whips the bails off and appeals which is taken upstairs by the square leg umpire. Replays roll in and show that the batsman was comfortably in.
A stumping referral against Mushfiqur Rahim is taken upstairs.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Super shot! Das sees the full length and a bit of width on this, he leans across and creams his drive through covers. His placement and timing are supreme which get a boundary and the first one of the innings.
Smart batting again by the experienced Rahim as he goes on the back foot to this back of a length ball around off and taps it into the point region to get a single.
Full length ball on off is driven to mid off.
This time he does well by opening the face a bit and steers it to third man to cross over and change strike.
Played to the point region by Das for no run.
Poor cricket all-round. Naib starts off with a short and wide delivery, Rahim cuts it well but straight to extra cover who misfields it and concedes the run. They need to buck up here.
Gulbadin Naib comes on to bowl.
Nicely driven to long on to retain the strike. Mujeeb gives just two again and is building some good pressure.
Rahim goes down and sweeps it nicely but straight to the man at square leg.
A bit shorter this, is flicked to mid-wicket.
Slightly slower around off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up on middle, kept away off the back foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, turned away into mid-wicket to get a run.
Fuller on off, driven to cover.
Fuller ball on middle is driven politely to mid on and Liton gets another single.

Soft hands were the key there as Rahim waits for the inward shaping length delivery on middle and off to come near him and tucks it into the square leg region to pick up a good single to get off the mark.
Smart batting as he steers this to third man to get off strike.
A fuller one this and a bit wide wide of off, Liton throws his bat at it and square drives it past the right of point to get another two.
A bit shorter in length, looks to tap it on the off side but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg.
Uses the angle to work it away on the leg side, but straight to the fielder. Another successful over for Afghanistan.
Comes half-forward on this occasion and presents a defensive bat in response.
Angling in on a shorter length on off, Rahim stays deep inside the crease and keeps it out off the back foot.
Mushfiqur Rahim to bat next. He walks in with Bangladesh in a spot of bother. Will have to play a big knock again.

OUT! That's dead plumb. No chance for Mithun to survive that from any angle. Two wickets in quick succession for Afghanistan. They're on a roll here. Coming in sharply from around off, like a medium pacer's delivery. Mithun looks to defend but gets caught on the front pad. Big appeal and the finger quickly goes up. The batsman didn't even think of taking the DRS, it was that obvious.
Full and in line of the stumps, driven towards mid on for a quick single.
Quicker one around off, it goes off the outer half on the off side and the batsmen take a single.
Mohammad Mithun is the new batsman in.

OUT! Good tight bowling from the other end has resulted in Shanto going for a non-existent shot against Alam and that has brought about his downfall. Alam keeps it fractionally short in line of the stumps and angles it across Hossain. Shanto looks to swing it wildly over the mid-wicket region, he loses his balance and ends up top edging it straight up in the air towards point where Rahmat Shah pouches it safely. First blood drawn by Afghanistan.

Das will be kicking himself for not punishing that full toss, Alam misses his length completely and ends up dishing out a knee high full toss angling into Das, Liton tries to swat that into the square leg region, tries to hit it a bit too hard and mistimes it to get just a single.
Driven through the covers, no chance of a run.
A fuller one this, is driven crisply to the right of mid off for a single.
Good intent shown by Shanto as he charges out and flicks a length ball towards mid-wicket but finds the fielder.
A bit shorter in length allows Das to wait that bit more and tap it into the point region to get off strike.
Again a bit full and on off, driven to mid off to end a good over by Mujeeb.
Full on off, defended off the front foot.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. Good tight bowling by Mujeeb so far.
Well bowled as he keeps it full on middle and off, Shanto does well to come forward and keep it out.
Fuller around off, Shanto has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower and bit shorter, pushed towards mid off and gets one.
Good delivery to end the over as he keeps it in the corridor around off and Shanto defends it off the front foot.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
A good length ball on off, angling into the batsmen, he taps it into the cover region for a single.
Walks down the track, very Hayden-esque, and flicks this short of a length delivery shaping into him over the mid-wicket region. The timing is not the best as the pair complete another brace.
A bit fuller and wide of off, Das decides to watchfully let it go.
Das has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Shanto does well to skip down the track and convert that into a low full toss, he drives it between the bowler and mid on and gets a brace to end the over.

First attacking shot against the mystery spinner as Das goes down on one knee and sweeps this hard but uppishly towards deep square leg. It goes to the fielder on the bounce and batsmen cross for a single.
Tossed up, Das played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Fuller this time on off, comes on the front foot and drives it into the gap through covers to pick up a run.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Starts with one which drifts into the batsman, Das flicks it into the square leg region and gets a single.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Nicely done. On the pads again, tucked behind square on the leg side and the batsmen rush to come back for the second. Good running.
A bit of a muted appeal but it's turned down, rightly so too, that pitched outside leg. Length ball which raps the southpaw high on the pads. He looks to flick but misses.
Moving away from the batsman from around off, a hint of extra bounce on that occasion. Shanto plays it off the outer half square on the off side.
Length delivery on middle and leg, defended solidly to the left of the bowler.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, on a good length, Shanto works it down gently in front of mid-wicket.
First runs of the afternoon. Liton Das reaches out to this length delivery outside off and runs it down to third man for a single.
Wide! False start for Aftab. Hurls it way wide outside off, Das doesn't have anything to do with that. It's across the tramline and that's a wide.

We are done and dusted with the national anthems of both teams and ready to begin proceedings. Out come the Bangladesh openers, Liton Das and Nazmul Hossain Shanto, walk out to the middle. Afghanistan spread out across the field after a last-minute pep talk from their skipper. It's a hot day, and Aftab Alam will be taking the new ball first up. He has a slip in place. Here we go...

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan says they also wanted to bat first. Informs that they have made one change as Samiullah Shenwari comes in place of Najibullah Zadran. Adds further that their team has rested and recovered well yesterday to get over the fatigue after playing back-to-back matches. Admits that their last match was tough and hence a bit tiring. Feels that today's game is also important and it was essential for them to get back to full fitness and give their best performance. Ends by saying that, now a days, Afghanistan team does not hope of just playing cricket but now they want to win matches as well.

Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza says they have made two changes, an extra spinner (Nazmul Islam making his debut) and Imrul Kayes come in. Adds further that in order to tackle the world class Afghan spinners their batters will have to play with confidence and back their technique. States that they will look to get a good start first and then will want to carry on from there. Reckons that it is important to drink lots of fluids and keep oneself hydrated in such hot conditions. Ends by saying that their team has recovered well in the rest they got yesterday and now is eager to give it its best shot.
TOSS -  The coin is flipped, Mortaza calls it right and Bangladesh elect to bat.

Hola, everyone, and welcome to the coverage of Match No. 4 of the Super Four stage between the passionate Bangladesh and the ever energetic Afghanistan. Having lost their first match of this stage against the tournament favorites, both teams will be keen on getting a win under their belt and keep their hopes of reaching the final alive. Also, even though they lost their last match, Afghanistan have a balanced side. However, Bangladesh's batting woes will haunt them as they will be missing their star opener, Tamim Iqbal and their batting in general seems to be struggling in the tournament. With the intensity and exuberance with which these two teams play, we definitely have an exciting contest on our hands. Also, another factor to watch out for is how the Tigers handle the world class Afghan spinners. Let's see who roars louder and manages to go one step ahead.
